Chapter 6493: Golden Bull

Chapter 6493: Golden Bull

The golden giant and ancestor of all gods fought evenly. Meanwhile, the power of life from Paramount coiled around the golden giant, turning into a maelstrom.

Although gentle instead of destructive, it was far more terrifying than any violent storm. It directed various affinities such as karma into the golden giant.

It was indiscernible at first but it would be too late once the signs became apparent. The various affinities of the dream world shrank and converged around the giant, pulling it down. Next, the endless force of life would try to drown it.

The giant already had a mighty foe. The addition of the maelstrom cracked its exterior, making it look covered in spiderwebs.

Would Gold Village crumble with the giant as well? Alch-deer and the others became grievously injured. Blood gushed out and stained their clothes.

Meanwhile, a skull flew out of the small room. He had a special soul with him. It glowed brilliantly as if it had withstood the test of time.

Within the light were images of the past - what the soul had lived through.

“It’s breaking down, damn.” The skull looked up and cursed: “Those two bastards must be doing this on purpose.”

“Must be.” The soul spoke.

“Shit, I don’t want to be crushed yet, wasn’t easy getting to this point.” The skull was livid.

Alas, there was no other choice. It drilled into the ground and returned to the source.

A golden light erupted from the room afterward, filling Gold Village to the brim. It nearly had a liquid form and empowered those inside the dream.

“What is this? Such power!” Alch-deer and the others were confused by the flood of golden power.

They roared and accepted the power influx. The giant became dazzlingly bright, blinding all of the dream world. It gained enough power to escape the maelstrom and repelled the ancestor of all gods.

“Rumble!” It stared in a different direction and got down on the ground.

Once it stood back up, it became a colossal bull instead of a humanoid entity. Its horns could destroy all the stars in the sky.

Golden energy oozed out of its nose like a tempest, sweeping away the minor dream realms.

“Ooo!” It roared and galloped toward the ancestor of gods, crushing the ground beneath and revealing the real world.

“Endless Form!” The ancestor attempted to stop it but was sent flying by a slam.

The bull didn’t stop and continued its momentum, flipping the ancestor into the air repeatedly.

After witnessing the beatdown, the primal ancestors in Paramount recalled the power of endless life.

“Longevity Heavenly Seal!” They roared and transformed life force into heavenly laws.

“Bam!” A seal appeared with a mystical azure behind, looking like the high heaven.

“Heaven Fall!” They roared and sent the seal against the frenzied bull.
